items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Doug Dobell Dougman who has the largest record shop in London, and we're very good friends

ctx.x: He sure should. No royalties to pay to anybody.

He's probably too smart to sell it, he probably leases it out, you know, to these different record companies. Because, I mean, when I was with Billy Eckstein, later, which I haven't gotten to, but we made some V disk in California with the armed forces that was not supposed to be used for personal -- I mean commercial purposes whatsoever. I got -- well, I know a man in London, Doug Dobell Dougman who has the largest record shop in London, and we're very good friends and all of the guys work with him. I hear from…

They sent me an album with the cover of our pictures on it and everything, and that V Disc. They sent that music, they sent it to me and I told Billy Eckstein about it, and you see what they do, they get ahold of this stuff and
